Now let's do a final verification. Also note that postgres was recreated during backup run (because backup run without profile recreated postgres?). Actually the recreate happened because `docker compose run --rm backup` used the base compose which doesn't publish ports, so postgres was recreated without ports, then I re-upped with local overlay so ports restored. All healthy.

Let me do final verification of API health and dashboard again.
